params.name: identifiers
params.description:
An optional filter on the resource server identifier. Must be URL encoded and may be specified multiple times (max 10).
e.g. ../resource-servers?identifiers=id1&identifiers=id2

params.name: page
params.description: Page index of the results to return. First page is 0.

params.name: include_totals
params.description: Return results inside an object that contains the total result count (true) or as a direct array of results (false, default).

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Whether specified fields are to be included (true) or excluded (false).
